product.name: Devotional & Prayer Group Platform
product.tagline: Create and join virtual satsangs, bhajan groups, and Quran study circles with attendance tracking

sections.problem_statement: Devotional communities currently rely on fragmented WhatsApp groups where event coordination is chaotic and attendance tracking is non-existent. Existing video conferencing tools lack the specialized UI required for spiritual engagement, such as synced audio for bhajans or prayer-specific content libraries. This product centralizes community management, providing a structured, distraction-free environment for spiritual practice with integrated attendance and participation analytics.
target_users: Sunita Sharma, Retired Teacher, Tier-2 City: Struggles to keep track of daily Bhajan Mandali schedules and member participation across multiple WhatsApp threads.
Imran Khan, Quran Study Circle Organizer, Metro City: Finds it difficult to manage attendance and share study materials securely with a rotating group of 50+ students.
Priya Nair, Working Professional, Corporate Sector: Wants to attend spiritual sessions but misses out due to lack of automated reminders and clear session agendas.
user_stories: As a group organizer, I want to create recurring event schedules so that members receive automated reminders and I can track attendance automatically.
As a participant, I want to access a central repository of prayer texts and audio files so that I can practice even when I am offline.
As a group organizer, I want to set up 'attendance goals' for members so that I can reward consistent participation with digital badges or certificates.
As a participant, I want to join sessions with 'one-tap' entry so that I don't have to hunt for meeting links in chat history.
As a community leader, I want to export attendance reports so that I can provide transparency to the temple or mosque committee regarding engagement levels.
mvp_features: Smart Calendar: Integrated scheduling tool that syncs with Google/Outlook to auto-generate meeting links and send WhatsApp reminders.
Attendance Tracker: Automated check-in system that logs session entry and duration, providing organizers with real-time participation dashboards.
Content Library: A secure media vault for hosting PDF prayer books, audio chants, and video study materials accessible only to group members.
In-App Notification Engine: Push and WhatsApp-based notification system to reduce drop-offs for scheduled live events.
Community Directory: A member-only profile view to foster trust and facilitate networking within the specific prayer circle.
Feedback Loop: A post-session rating system to help organizers understand which topics or prayer styles resonate most with their members.
future_features: Live-stream monetization (Micro-donations via UPI) to enable organizers to raise funds for community causes.
AI-powered prayer assistant to summarize study sessions and generate key takeaways for absent members.
Integrated Peer-to-Peer mentorship matching to pair new members with experienced practitioners.
Offline-first sync mode to allow users in low-bandwidth areas to access cached prayer materials.
success_metrics: Daily Active Users (DAU): Reach 5,000 DAU by Month 6 — indicates core utility and daily habit formation.
Event Attendance Rate: Sustain 70% average attendance per scheduled session — measures the effectiveness of the reminder system.
Retention Rate (D30): Achieve 40% retention for new group organizers — validates the product's value proposition for community leaders.
Viral Coefficient: Reach 1.2 by Month 4 — measures organic growth via referral invites within existing spiritual circles.
assumptions: Users are comfortable with basic smartphone navigation and have consistent access to high-speed mobile data.
Spiritual groups are willing to migrate from WhatsApp to a dedicated platform if it reduces their administrative overhead.
The target demographic values privacy and expects compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.
risks: Content sensitivity and moderation: Implement AI-based automated filtering and human-in-the-loop reporting for inappropriate content.
Low technical literacy among older cohorts: Develop an 'Easy Mode' UI with large fonts and voice-command navigation.
Data privacy concerns: Ensure all user data is encrypted at rest and in transit, with granular control over who can view member profiles.
sections.go_to_market: Leverage partnerships with local community influencers and religious centers to host their first pilot sessions on the platform. Utilize a 'Community-Led Growth' strategy where organizers are incentivized with premium features for inviting other groups. Focus on high-density spiritual hubs in cities like Varanasi, Rishikesh, and Hyderabad to build early density and brand trust.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Build using a No-Code stack like FlutterFlow for the frontend to ensure rapid cross-platform deployment. Use Firebase for real-time database and authentication, ensuring seamless scaling. Integrate with Twilio for WhatsApp API messaging and Razorpay for future payment processing.
sections.monetisation: Freemium model: Free for groups up to 20 members, with a 'Premium Organizer' tier at ₹199/month for advanced analytics and storage. Introduce a 'Donation-as-a-Service' feature taking a 2% platform fee on voluntary contributions to religious causes. Expand to a B2B model for large-scale institutions requiring custom branding and dedicated support at ₹2,499/month.
